description: Full pre-trade decision card: orchestrates position sizing, breakeven, liquidation, and funding cost in one call. Use when user describes a full trade setup and asks "should I take this trade?" or "run the numbers on this setup". Provide exchange+symbol to fetch live funding rate automatically. For an R:R-graded verdict on an entry, stop and target, see workflow.run_risk_reward. Returns: positionSize, breakeven, liquidationPrice, fundingCost, overnightBreakevenShift, verdict.

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default), inverse = coin-margined (e.g. Bybit BTCUSD). All returned figures (notional, margin, risk_amount, funding_cost_*) stay USD-denominated either way; recommended_size is USD notional (contracts) for inverse.

exchange.description: Exchange code, e.g. "binance" or "bybit". Used to fetch the live funding rate if funding_rate is omitted, and to set funding_interval_hours when that is omitted (1 for Hyperliquid, dYdX, Kraken and Backpack, whose rates are per hour; pass funding_interval_hours: 8 if you supply a rate that is per 8 hours). With funding_rate omitted and fetched live, funding_interval_hours is ignored and the interval the exchange reports for the symbol is used.

funding_interval_hours.description: Hours per funding payment, the period funding_rate covers: 8 on most venues, 1 on Hyperliquid, dYdX, Kraken and Backpack, 4 or 2 on some symbols of Binance, Bybit, OKX, Gate, KuCoin, MEXC, Aster and Phemex. When funding_rate is omitted and fetched live (exchange and symbol given), any value passed here is ignored: the interval of that symbol as the exchange reports it is used (else the exchange default). Omitted otherwise: when you pass funding_rate yourself, the exchange default (1 for hourly venues, else 8), so pass funding_interval_hours for a symbol that pays every 4 or 2 hours.

funding_rate.description: Funding rate per funding interval as decimal, e.g. 0.0001. If omitted, fetched live from exchange.

hold_hours.description: Expected hold time in hours for overnight shift calc. Default 8.
